title: VARA AI Fund Collapses 16 Months After Raising $26.4B
summary:
A hedge fund targeting artificial intelligence investments has reportedly blown up after a rapid expansion of its capital base. The VARA AI fund, managed by a young executive, grew to approximately $26.4B in assets under management by the end of June, just 16 months after its inception.

The firm operated with only 9 employees, sparking scrutiny over whether the manager ignored basic principles of correlation and value at risk (VaR). Industry observers are now questioning if the fund had any of its market exposure hedged with options to prevent the collapse.
